articles.title: Chef Tam's Seasons at Wynn Palace Once Again Ranks Among The 50 Best Restaurants 2026 51-100 List
articles.summary: Chef Tam's Seasons, the signature Cantonese restaurant at Wynn Palace, once again ranks among The 50 Best Restaurants 2026, taking the No.73 spot on the 51-100 list and remaining the only restaurant in Macao on the ranking. It also ranked No.7 in The 50 Best Restaurants Asia 2026, announced in March — the third consecutive year it has been the only Macao restaurant on that list.

articles.title: GEG Recognized as Top Winner at HR Excellence Awards 2026; Honored with the Grand Winner Award for its Excellence in Talent Development
articles.summary: Galaxy Entertainment Group received eight accolades at the HR Excellence Awards 2026, organised by Human Resources Online, including the Grand Winner Award — the only integrated tourism and leisure enterprise in Macau among this year's recipients. The other honours include five Gold awards for employee development, leadership development, internship recruitment, volunteerism and ESG strategy, plus Silver for employee care and wellbeing and Bronze for learning and development.

articles.title: POLY MGM MUSEUM Named to Fortune China’s 2026 Best Design List
articles.summary: The POLY MGM MUSEUM, jointly established by Poly Culture Group and MGM, has been named to Fortune China's 2026 Best Design list, standing as the only project from Macau recognised this year. The honour was presented at the Fortune China Best Design 2026 Awards Ceremony in Chengdu on 22 October.

articles.title: Wynn Scoops 16 Accolades at "China's Wine List of the Year Awards" Reaffirming its Excellence in Gastronomy and Wine
articles.summary: Wynn secured 16 accolades at the 14th China's Wine List of the Year Awards, with eight signature restaurants earning the highest “3 Glasses” distinction. Chef Tam's Seasons at Wynn Palace scooped five awards, and Mizumi retained “China's Best Sake List” for a second consecutive year.
